name: tracelab
description: A local-first API debugging workbench for composing, executing, and inspecting HTTP requests.
author: TraceLab contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @tracelab/server" "npm run dev --workspace @tracelab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tracelab/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracelab/server && npm run build --workspace @tracelab/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @tracelab/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracelab/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracelab/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @tracelab/shared && npm run test --workspace @tracelab/server && npm run test --workspace @tracelab/web
